"""ASVS capability questions: which the floor drops, and where level 1 ranks."""
import statistics
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

from analysis_service.answer_round import EARLY_RULES, ROUND_DECISIONS
from analysis_service.capabilities import lineage
from analysis_service.early_questions import capability_questions
from analysis_service.frameworks.asvs.applicability import applicability_for
from analysis_service.frameworks.asvs.catalog import requirement_level
from analysis_service.report import Report

floor = EARLY_RULES["capability"].floor
stats = Counter()
first_round_l1, listed_l1 = [], []
for path in sorted(Path("evals").rglob("*.report.json")):
    report = Report.model_validate_json(path.read_text())
    options = {s.name: s.options for s in report.job.frameworks}
    if "asvs" not in options:
        continue
    level = options["asvs"]["level"]
    decisions = applicability_for(level, report.system_model.capability_facts())
    levels: dict[str, set[int]] = {}
    for requirement, decision in decisions.items():
        for missing in decision.missing:
            for key in (missing, *lineage(missing)):
                levels.setdefault(key, set()).add(requirement_level(requirement))
    asked = capability_questions(report.system_model, {"asvs": options["asvs"]})
    stats["reports"] += 1
    stats[f"level {level} jobs"] += 1
    kept = [q for q in asked if q.score >= floor]
    dropped = [q for q in asked if q.score < floor]
    tag = f"L{level} jobs"
    stats[f"{tag}: listed"] += len(asked)
    stats[f"{tag}: kept"] += len(kept)
    stats[f"{tag}: dropped"] += len(dropped)
    stats[f"{tag}: dropped settling a level-1 requirement"] += sum(1 for q in dropped if 1 in levels.get(q.key[5], set()))
    stats[f"{tag}: kept settling a level-1 requirement"] += sum(1 for q in kept if 1 in levels.get(q.key[5], set()))
    stats[f"{tag}: kept settling only level 2+"] += sum(1 for q in kept if levels.get(q.key[5]) and 1 not in levels[q.key[5]])
    # Where the level-1 questions sit in today's order, in choices.
    budget, first = ROUND_DECISIONS, set()
    for q in kept:
        if budget <= 0:
            break
        first.add(q.key)
        budget -= q.decisions
    l1 = [q for q in kept if 1 in levels.get(q.key[5], set())]
    first_round_l1.append(sum(1 for q in l1 if q.key in first))
    listed_l1.append(len(l1))
for key, value in stats.items():
    print(f"{key}: {value}")
print("level-1 questions kept, a job (median):", statistics.median(listed_l1),
      "| of them in round 1 (median):", statistics.median(first_round_l1))

"""After #1289's capability bands: what a level 1 and a level 2 ASVS job ask."""
import statistics
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

from analysis_service.answer_round import question_set
from analysis_service.early_questions import capability_questions
from analysis_service.report import Report

per = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(list))
for path in sorted(Path("evals").rglob("*.report.json")):
    report = Report.model_validate_json(path.read_text())
    options = {s.name: s.options for s in report.job.frameworks}
    if "asvs" not in options:
        continue
    asvs = {"asvs": options["asvs"]}
    level = options["asvs"]["level"]
    listed = capability_questions(report.system_model, asvs)
    qs = question_set(report.system_model, None, asvs, [], waiting=True, answered=[],
                      answered_links=[], final=False, shown=[])
    first = [q for q in qs.early if q.kind == "capability"]
    row = per[f"L{level}"]
    row["listed"].append(len(listed))
    row["eligible"].append(qs.remaining["capability"] + qs.withheld)
    row["asked (limit 30)"].append(qs.remaining["capability"])
    row["round 1 settling level 1"].append(sum(1 for q in first if q.band == 3))
    row["round 1"].append(len(first))
for level, row in sorted(per.items()):
    print(level, {k: statistics.median(v) for k, v in row.items()}, "jobs", len(row["listed"]))
